listingTitle: Avoid dynamic Bevy font atlas growth
title: Avoid dynamic Bevy font atlas growth
why: Bevy creates a separate font atlas for each font and size, and dynamically interpolating TextFont font_size or UiScale scale can create expensive atlas memory that is not reclaimed.
suggestion: Keep font sizes discrete and animate Transform::scale instead, or explicitly configure TextSettings when dynamic font sizes are intentional.
limitations: Only direct compound mutations or assignments involving common time/interpolation expressions in Update or FixedUpdate systems are reported.
The rule recognizes direct TextFont query loop bindings and ResMut<UiScale> bindings, and is disabled when allow_dynamic_font_size: true is present.
